H4111G.name: Mahalalel
H4111G.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H4111G.brief: Descendant of Seth; ancestor of Noah
H4111G.short: Mahalalel was a descendant of Seth and an ancestor of Noah, living before the flood.

H4111H.name: Mahalalel
H4111H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4111H.brief: Descendant of Perez; lived in Jerusalem after the exile
H4111H.short: Mahalalel, a descendant of Perez, lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H4121.name: Maharai
H4121.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H4121.brief: One of David's mighty warriors from Netophah
H4121.short: Maharai the Netophathite was one of David's mighty warriors and served as a commander in his army.

H4122.name: Maher-shalal-hash-baz
H4122.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4122.brief: Symbolic name given to Isaiah's son, meaning "swift is booty, speedy is prey."
H4122.short: Maher-shalal-hash-baz, meaning "swift is booty, speedy is prey," was the symbolic name given to Isaiah's son.
H4122.meaning: Maher-shalal-hash-baz “swift is booty, speedy is prey”

forms.meaning: Maher-shalal-hash-baz “swift is booty, speedy is prey”

H4105G.name: Mehetabel
H4105G.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4105G.brief: Wife of Hadar, king of Edom.
H4105G.short: Mehetabel was the wife of Hadar, a king of Edom.

H4105H.name: Mehetabel
H4105H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4105H.brief: Ancestor of Shemaiah, who opposed Nehemiah.
H4105H.short: Mehetabel was an ancestor of Shemaiah, who opposed Nehemiah's efforts to rebuild Jerusalem's walls.

H4104.name: Mehuman
H4104.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4104.brief: One of King Ahasuerus' seven eunuchs.
H4104.short: Mehuman was one of the seven eunuchs who served King Ahasuerus.

H4199.name: Mizzah
H4199.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4199.brief: A grandson of Esau and a chief of Edom.
H4199.short: Mizzah was a grandson of Esau and one of the chiefs of Edom listed in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

H4124H.name: Moab
H4124H.desc: Moabite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4124H.brief: Son of Lot, born from an incestuous relationship.
H4124H.short: Moab, the son of Lot by his eldest daughter, was the ancestor of the Moabite people.

H4140.name: Molid
H4140.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4140.brief: Son of Abisur, of the tribe of Judah.
H4140.short: Molid was the son of Abisur and Abihail, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H4162G.name: Moza
H4162G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4162G.brief: Son of Caleb by his concubine Ephah
H4162G.short: Moza was a son of Caleb, the renowned spy, by his concubine Ephah.

H4162H.name: Moza
H4162H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4162H.brief: Son of Zimri, descendant of King Saul
H4162H.short: Moza, a Benjamite, was a descendant of King Saul.

H4187.name: Mushi
H4187.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4187.brief: A Levite, son of Merari, and head of a clan.
H4187.short: Mushi was a son of Merari and a grandson of Levi, who became the head of the Mushite clan within the Levitical tribe.

H4158.name: Mephaath
H4158.brief: A Levitical city in Reuben, later Moabite
H4158.short: Mephaath, a Levitical city in the territory of Reuben (<ref="Joshua 13:18; 21:37; 1Ch.6.79">Joshua 13:18; 21:37; 1Ch.6.79</ref>), later mentioned in a prophecy against Moab (<ref="Jeremiah 48:21">Jeremiah 48:21</ref>).

H4124G.name: Moab
H4124G.brief: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan
H4124G.short: Moab was an ancient kingdom located east of the Dead Sea in present-day Jordan, often in conflict with Israel.

H4124I.name: Moab Plains
H4124I.brief: Region east of the Jordan River, opposite Jericho
H4124I.short: The plains of Moab, located east of the Jordan River and opposite Jericho, were where the Israelites camped before entering the Promised Land (<ref="Num.22.1; 26:3, 63; 31:12; 33:48-50; 35:1; 36:13; Deut 34:1, 8; Josh 13:32">Num.22.1; 26:3, 63; 31:12; 33:48-50; 35:1; 36:13; Deut 34:1, 8; Josh 13:32</ref>).

H4137.name: Moladah
H4137.brief: Town in the Negev, allotted to Judah and Simeon
H4137.short: Moladah was a town in the Negev region, allotted to the tribes of Judah and Simeon, and later inhabited by the people of Judah after the Babylonian exile (<ref="Josh 15:26; 19:2; 1Ch.4.28; Neh.11.26">Josh 15:26; 19:2; 1Ch.4.28; Neh.11.26</ref>).

H4176G.name: Moreh
H4176G.brief: Place near Shechem; also a hill near Gilgal
H4176G.short: Moreh refers to two locations: a place near Shechem where Abraham built an altar (<ref="Gen.12.6">Gen.12.6</ref>) and a hill near Gilgal, associated with the blessing and cursing ceremony (<ref="Deut 11:30">Deut 11:30</ref>).

H4176H.name: Moreh
H4176H.brief: Place near Shechem; hill where Gideon camped
H4176H.short: Moreh refers to a place near Shechem associated with Abraham (<ref="Gen.12.6">Gen.12.6</ref>) and a hill where Gideon camped before attacking the Midianites (<ref="Judg 7:1">Judg 7:1</ref>).

H4182.name: Moresheth
H4182.brief: Hometown of the prophet Micah in Judah
H4182.short: Moresheth was the hometown of the prophet Micah, located in Judah.

H4179.name: Moriah Mount
H4179.brief: Site of Solomon's temple in Jerusalem
H4179.short: Mount Moriah was the site where Solomon built the temple in Jerusalem.

H4149A.name: Moserah
H4149A.brief: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings
H4149A.short: Moserah was a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings, and where Aaron died and was buried.

H4149B.name: Moseroth
H4149B.brief: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings
H4149B.short: Moseroth was a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings after leaving Egypt.

H4192.name: Muth-labben
H4192.brief: Musical term or tune in a psalm title
H4192.short: Muth-labben, a phrase of uncertain meaning, appears in the title of Psalm 9.
